$comment: Free and open source projects that can appear as keys in a device's `support` matrix. Adding a project here is what makes its slug valid — the validator rejects unknown ones, so a typo cannot quietly fragment the matrix into two half-populated columns. `licence` is recorded because whether you may take code from a project, as opposed to facts, depends on it — and because only free and open source projects belong in the matrix. A support column is an endorsement of sorts, and this database does not exist to route people towards paid software.
